<thought>I will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks an aliphatic C‑O bond (hydroxyl) and forms a C‑X (halogen) bond, matching the described substitution. I’ll use a generic target SMILES that contains both fragments from the precursors, assuming the product is a combined molecule. This should return templates, from which I can pick the one that matches and retrieve its mapped reaction and ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=Cc1ccc(F)cc1Clc1ccc(CN2CC(F)C2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkyl_halide"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-Cl"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
